claim: **《论自由》的核心主张——个人对自身的主权与社会权威的边界（伤害原则）**：第四章以设问开场 `the rightful limit to the sovereignty of the individual over himself?`，即问「对个人自己，正当的主权边界何在、社会权威从何开始」——本章正是伤害原则（社会对个人行使强制的唯一正当理由在于防止伤害他人）的系统化所在；而在体系上，该边界以最大幸福（效用）为道德地基——`The creed which accepts as the foundation of morals, Utility, or the Greatest Happiness Principle, holds that actions are right in proportion as they tend to promote happiness, wrong as they tend to produce the reverse of happiness.`，即强制个人的正当性最终由「促进幸福而非产生不幸」来判定。　［出处：《On Liberty》1863（src-4e339d410c73）；《Utilitarianism》1863（src-ddd3c72adeb3）。OCR：On Liberty 本章标题行印作「OV THE LIMITS TO THE AUTHORITT OF SOCISTT OYER THE INDIVIDUAL」「WHAT,」等大写讹形，引文取句中片段避开大小写噪声；Utilitarianism 原文「in pro portion」为行尾断词+软连字符，按原词合并为「in proportion」］

claim: **他视政治经济学为一门由精确分析获得「相对精确科学性格」的理论学科，并坚持它是假设性的抽象演绎科学**：他对 Ricardo 的评价——`Of the truths with which political economy has been enriched by Mr. Ricardo, none has contributed more to give to that branch of knowledge the comparatively precise and scientific character which it at present bears, than the more accurate analysis which he performed of the nature of the advantage which nations derive from a mutual interchange of their productions.`；贸易利得由此被严格定义：`He shewed, that the advantage of an interchange of commodities between nations consists simply and solely in this, that it enables each to obtain, with a given amount of labour and capital, a greater quantity of all commodities taken together.`（比较成本原理的前提）；并把这类科学的性质定位为假设性的——`Their conclusions are only true on certain suppositions, which are, or ought to be, approximations to the truth`（Hypothetical Sciences；句续 “but are seldom, if ever, exactly true”，原文 “ti’ue” 为 “true” 的 OCR 讹形）。　［出处：《Essays on Some Unsettled Questions of Political Economy》1844（src-568eb932c905）；《A System of Logic》1884（src-60a849fa8c49）。OCR：Unsettled 本段前后印有排印强调标记（`_absolute_`/`_comparative_`），引文避开］
